Esther Yu: Why is it still these few dishes? (Chef Lin prepared more of season 8’s dishes) We have already arrived upon a new destination.

Esther Yu: Why didn’t you update the menu? 

Chef Lin: Are you okay? (Yes okay HAHA) Your clothes still show you’re at France.

Esther Yu insistingly: We are now at Morocco

Chef Lin: Miss, this is season 8. We are at France.

A little show explanation:
To summarise, Chef Lin has not received any invitation to attend ZCT9. In a haste, he contacted Esther Yu in hopes to convince the producer together to let him attend ZCT9. Therefore, they are neither at France or Morocco. They are at Quan Zhou, one of China’s region xD 

Chef Lin then proceeded to call Zhai Xiao Wen and Huang Xiao Ming, in hopes to gain some support or get some news on him attending ZCT9. Both unfortunately did not pick up so he went on to call the producer.

When Chef Lin asked the producer on whether the chef list has been determined, producer went on to reply that the country chosen is free from registration. Hence, if tomorrow he agreed to Chef Lin attending, he can pack up and fly instantly. Making the transportation plan very convenient. While for chef list, it is at the midst of arranging as the theme of this season is entrepreneurship so they are looking for someone with a young spirit and mindset.
